From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Equinox - RCA draft (internal)

Team — attaching the RCA draft (equinox_rca_draft.pdf). High-level findings:

1) Root cause: a regression in the runtime's KV-cache eviction logic after a model variant rollout; heavy prefix churn caused repeated cache misses and excessive token decoding overhead under checkout request patterns.
2) Contributing factors: rollout without targeted canary for longer-sequence paths; reduced cache size on the affected nodes due to an autoscaler config change; lack of pre-release integration test for long-prefix throughput.
3) Impact window: 03:20–03:52 UTC; average p95 from 1.2s -> 8.6s; error rate (5xx) increased from 0.02% -> 1.8% for affected routes.

Planned corrective actions (owners & timelines):
- Revert model variant + pin stable variant (owner: Markus) — Immediate, completed 12/14 09:40 PST
- Restore cache config to previous sizing (owner: Jonas) — Completed 12/14 10:20 PST
- Hotfix to eviction heuristic and add telemetry (owner: Runtime team) — PR in review, target 12/17
- Add pre-deploy long-prefix perf test to CI (owner: Marissa & QE) — in sprint, target 12/24
- Customer validation plan (owner: Jonas) — attached validation_schedule.xlsx

Please review the draft and flag any changes before we send to Nora. I included sample graphs and native logs in the appendix.

Attachments: equinox_rca_draft.pdf, validation_schedule.xlsx

-Markus
Markus Klein
Sr. Director, Runtime Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Equinox RCA & remediation commitments (executive summary)

Nora / Samir —

Please find attached our final RCA and executive summary (equinox_rca_final.pdf). Executive highlights:
- Confirmed root cause: KV-cache eviction regression after model variant rollout (impacting long-prefix checkout patterns).
- Immediate mitigations taken: pinned stable model variant; restored cache sizing; increased capacity on affected nodes — these actions restored p95 to pre-incident levels within ~40 minutes of detection.
- Next steps & timing: hotfix to eviction logic (target 12/17), CI long-prefix perf tests (target 12/24), and a 2-week validation window to run customer-side verification steps.

As discussed, we will offer a one-time SLA credit for the incident window. I’ve attached a draft SLA credit agreement; if you’re comfortable we can route for signature and close-out. Jonas will follow up with the exact validation schedule and the step-by-step checklist.

Thanks for your patience — we own this and will demonstrate the validation results.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
